records.title: Full 5-torsion of the regular-pentagon quintic pencil
records.description:
This research note computes all twenty-five geometric fifth-torsion points of the genus-one normalization of the regular-pentagon quintic pencil in McCallum's Question 17 in the AIM workshop problem list on rational and integral points. For an explicit equation normalization over K=Q(sqrt(5)), it gives a cubic model, both birational maps, a degree-ten residual polynomial and both ordinate branches. The complete division field is K(sqrt(5+2sqrt(5)),zeta_5,theta), where theta^5=lambda+phi^5 and phi=(1+sqrt(5))/2. Its degree is four or twenty, with the exact splitting criterion and Galois action specified. The computation covers every elliptic normalization, including the allowed cuspidal plane member.

The proof applies classical Tate normal form, Fisher's full-level modular cover, Verdure's full-torsion specialization criterion, Morton's prior explicit Tate torsion formulas and residual polynomial, division-polynomial theory and the Weil pairing. It credits the source's known infinity subgroup and the earlier partial computation. No first-discovery or first-priority claim is made. The verification supplement supplies portable exact symbolic and standard-library arithmetic controls, independent finite group-law checks, deliberate mutants, primary references and a bounded priority audit. Nonregular or star-polygon variants and Tate-Shafarevich or local-solubility constructions are outside the stated theorem.

This is an unrefereed preprint. AI tools were used extensively in derivation, computation, literature research, writing, reproduction and adversarial review. Automated reviews are not independent external human peer review; no such human review or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.
